purpose: A redo of the videotape from carry-props-01 (story/phone.md), after the user's note on it: 'shouldn't it have some tape showing on the right side as well? I'm not sure'. A rewound VHS has all its tape on the left reel and none on the right, which is what the first pictures showed; one stopped part-way has tape on both. Both are offered: the tape as it lands in Minato's letterbox (rewound), and as it is once he has watched some of it (stopped part-way), which is how Mack finds it. Label blank: the game writes on it. Nothing goes into the game without the user's approval.
